## Utah National Parks Family Adventure

Embark on a memorable 5-day family road trip through the stunning landscapes of Zion and Bryce Canyon National Parks in Utah. This itinerary is designed for families with children aged 8 and 12, balancing scenic drives with light, kid-friendly hikes and opportunities to explore the unique geological wonders of Southern Utah during the first week of June 2025.

### Trip Context & Assumptions

-   **Starting/Ending Point**: Las Vegas, Nevada (a common and convenient gateway for Southern Utah parks).
-   **Budget**: Moderate, aiming for $200-$300 per day for accommodation and park activities. This budget allows for comfortable lodging, park entrance fees, and a mix of picnic meals and casual dining.
-   **Travel Style**: Focus on scenic drives, light to moderate hiking, and immersing in nature.

### 5-Day Itinerary: Zion & Bryce Canyon

#### Day 1: Arrival in Las Vegas & Drive to Springdale (Zion National Park)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/car-front.svg
-   **Morning**: Arrive at Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) in Las Vegas, pick up your rental car.
-   **Route & Drive**: Drive approximately 2.5-3 hours north on I-15 N to Springdale, the gateway town to Zion National Park.
-   **Afternoon**: Check into your accommodation in Springdale. Take some time to relax by the Virgin River or explore the town's shops.
-   **Scenic Stop**: Enjoy the changing desert landscape as you drive, particularly the Virgin River Gorge just after entering Arizona.
-   **Light Hike**: A gentle stroll along the Pa'rus Trail near the park entrance (you can do a short section today or save for Day 3).
-   **Food**: Casual dinner in Springdale, offering various family-friendly options.
-   **Overnight Stay**: Springdale, Utah.
Action: [Button: Explore Springdale Lodging] https://www.nps.gov/zion/planyourvisit/lodging.htm

#### Day 2: Zion National Park - Emerald Pools & Canyon Views
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
-   **Morning**: Take the free park shuttle into Zion Canyon. Hike the **Lower and Middle Emerald Pools Trails** (easy to moderate, ~2-3 miles round trip). Kids will enjoy the waterfalls and lush greenery.
-   **Route & Drive**: Utilize the park's scenic shuttle system to navigate Zion Canyon. Private vehicles are generally not allowed on the main scenic drive during peak season.
-   **Afternoon**: Continue on the shuttle to explore other viewpoints like **Weeping Rock** (currently closed for repairs, check NPS website for updates) or **Big Bend**. Enjoy a picnic lunch by the Virgin River.
-   **Scenic Stop**: The entire Zion Canyon Scenic Drive offers breathtaking views of the towering sandstone cliffs. The shuttle allows everyone to take in the scenery.
-   **Light Hike**: The Emerald Pools Trails are perfect for the family. Consider the **Riverside Walk** (easy, paved, leads to the Narrows entrance) in the late afternoon.
-   **Food**: Pack a picnic lunch to enjoy inside the park. Dinner in Springdale.
-   **Overnight Stay**: Springdale, Utah.
Action: [Button: Zion Shuttle Info] https://www.nps.gov/zion/planyourvisit/zion-canyon-shuttle-system.htm

#### Day 3: Pa'rus Trail & Drive to Bryce Canyon National Park
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
-   **Morning**: Enjoy a leisurely morning. Walk the full **Pa'rus Trail** (easy, paved, 3.5 miles round trip) from the Visitor Center, suitable for all ages and even strollers. It follows the Virgin River and offers beautiful riverside views.
-   **Route & Drive**: Depart Springdale and drive east on UT-9 (Zion-Mount Carmel Highway), through the famous Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, then north on US-89, and finally east on UT-12 to Bryce Canyon National Park. This drive is approximately 1.5-2 hours.
-   **Afternoon**: Arrive at Bryce Canyon City or Tropic, check into your lodging.
-   **Scenic Stop**: The drive on UT-9 through Zion's east side offers incredible, often less crowded, views. Don't miss the Checkerboard Mesa.
-   **Light Hike**: The Pa'rus Trail.
-   **Food**: Lunch in Springdale or a packed lunch for the drive. Dinner in Bryce Canyon City.
-   **Overnight Stay**: Bryce Canyon City or Tropic, Utah.
Action: [Button: Bryce Canyon Lodging] https://www.nps.gov/brca/planyourvisit/lodging.htm
